scope: Compact replacement CO2 secondary regulator; manufacturer suitability and signed-in Amazon Prime availability research

purchase_criteria.ports: Native 6.35 mm OD push-connect inlet and outlet
purchase_criteria.medium: CO2 gas, with a downstream check protecting the regulator from reverse water flow
purchase_criteria.setting: Adjustable through the selected approximately 3 bar carbonator setting
purchase_criteria.availability: In stock with immediate dispatch; Amazon Prime offers only

best_technical_candidate.regulator_type: Downstream pressure-reducing inline regulator, not a spunding or flow-control valve
best_technical_candidate.construction: Acetal/POM, EPDM seals, stainless gripping teeth
best_technical_candidate.gauge: Integrated 0-150 psi gauge; its published approximate +/-15 psi accuracy does not establish a precise 43.5 psi setting
best_technical_candidate.dimensions_status: No manufacturer overall drawing found; photograph-scaled dimensions are not a received-part measurement

photo_estimate_mm.scale_basis: Manufacturer's 27 mm gauge face in a near-normal front photograph

best_technical_candidate.amazon_check: The exact KL26918 Prime-filtered search returned no results. Prime-filtered brand, Duotight family and broader inline push-connect/secondary-gas searches did not establish a matching purchase offer.
best_technical_candidate.selection: Technical candidate only; no replacement selected for the production pack

other_manufacturer_findings.finding: Integrated check and regulator, but a proprietary manifold inlet rather than a second native 1/4-inch tube socket. Internal check position relative to regulation is not established by a published section.
Compact 2-inch body; barbed/threaded interfaces and a separate setting tool, not two native push-connect ports.
0-4 bar and 3/8-inch John Guest ports; substantially larger than the selected compact gas lane.
8 mm barbs; published 0-70 psi inlet range is below the normal 75 psi feed.
Barbed or 1/4-inch NPT interfaces; no compact native two-socket replacement established.

user_linked_water_regulator.finding: Native 1/4-inch push-connects, but no CO2 suitability established in the seller/manufacturer material reviewed; the fixed 60 psi also differs from the selected secondary setting. This is not evidence that the part physically fails on gas.

result: No immediate-dispatch Prime purchase meeting the complete requested combination was verified in this search. The TPU arrangement remains an isolated layout alternative using retained metal bodies.
